text_block_list.text:
Special Week asks me to come to the
trainer's
office on Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! You came!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's Valentine's Day today, so I made you
some
chocolate!

I look over at the desk to find something
huge
and imposing sitting on it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
My mom always used to tell me,
"Cooking is love!
And you don't skimp
on love!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I jam-packed all my gratitude for you
into them!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I actually wanted to make you enough
chocolate
to get full off of, but I was
advised against it.

Frankly, I'm shocked by the implication
that
Special Week can finish all the
chocolate before
us and still have room
for more.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Let me know if this isn't enough! I can
make you
as much as you want.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
This is to repay you for everything you
always do
for me, so feel free to ask for
more!

I manage to conquer Special Week's
chocolate
mountain through sheer
willpower.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Looks like you enjoyed the
chocolates.
Thank goodness!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I know! How about I make you some
more? I've
still got ingredients left!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Gahhh! Trainer?! Are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Please, open your eyes! Trainerrrr!

And that's lights out for Valentine's Day
with
Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Trainer? Could you try some of
the
chocolate now?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I made sure to sample them when I was
cooking,
but I can always remake them if
you don't like
them!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Really?! Thank goodness!

Special Week's stomach grumbles after
her
exclamation of relief.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry! Watching you eat has made me
all hungry
too...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I thought you'd never ask! Yaaay! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Nom.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Food tastes twice as good when you eat
it with a
friend!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Nope! I was just thinking that. It's true,
though! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! ♪ Happy Valentine's Day,
Trainer!

Special Week and I spend a
heartwarming
Valentine's Day together.
